name: RIDE HOME
source:
A linear visual novel about giving a ride home to a coworker. A toxic yuri story about flawed perception told from the POV of a dashcam over the course of 9 weeks.

[Edited from [url=https://tabbiedearest.itch.io/ride-home]itch.io[/url]]
